description_expanded: Overview5.0(13 reviews)Steps to Community Lagoon Pool - Private Beach - Free Tram - 2 Bikes -`Bella Bella`The Space Bella Bella – Cozy Seacrest Beach Retreat with Pool & Beach Tram Access! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Access to 12,000 Sq. Ft. Lagoon Pool – One of the largest resort pools on 30A! 2 Adult Bikes Included – Explore Seacrest, Rosemary & Alys Beach with ease Spacious Porches & Cozy Fireplace – Perfect for relaxing after a beach day Seacrest Beach Tram Service (March - October) – Free shuttle to and from the beach 2 Comfortable Bedrooms / 2.5 Bathrooms – Ideal for couples or small families Fully Equipped Kitchen – Stocked with all essentials for at-home meals Complimentary Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Stay connected & entertained Walking Distance to Shops & Restaurants – Enjoy Acme Ice House, Shades, George’s & more Driveway Parking for 2 Vehicles – Hassle-free & convenient Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free vacationWelcome to Bella BellaThis adorable 2 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom vacation home features spacious porches, a fireplace, and fully equipped kitchen. With a queen bed in the master, a queen in the guest bedroom, easy access to the community pool, WIFI, and a fully stocked kitchen this property is sure to accommodate you like a home away from home. And for when you choose to venture out to the beautiful white sands, the Seacrest Beach North tram service will shuttle you and your family to the emerald waters upon request.Whether you choose to spend your time in the sun or visiting many of the eclectic local shops and fantastic restaurants (Acme Ice House, Shades, George's) located conveniently within walking distance, Bella Bella is sure to make your vacation a relaxing getaway to remember.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Nearest Beach Access - .39 miles – Beach access is at Seacrest Beach II – Directly across the street from the entrance of Seacrest Beach North.SCBN community offers a beach shuttle service (free) to take guest to and from the beach.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 4):Master Bedroom: Queen sized bed, private bathroom with shower/tubGuest Bedroom: Queen sized bed, private bathroom with shower/tubAREA ATTRACTIONS:This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand.A lively community gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.Show less
